interactions.note: The rider depends on the roll actually having Advantage. Covered by the cancelled-Advantage, 2-Advantage-vs-1-Disadvantage and long-range Shortbow tests.
On a crit the extra d4 is doubled. With static damage the rider must still add its 2; the engine drops it (red).

interactions.with: GLOSS.disengage, GLOSS.hide, Opportunity Attack, Bonus Action economy
interactions.note: Disengage blocks the Opportunity Attack for the turn only. Hide needs DC 15, cover and no one seeing it. Only one Bonus Action per turn, and only the two named actions.
In Darkness the goblin sees a target without Darkvision while the target can't see it, so its attack has Advantage and triggers the +1d4.
Trap from 2014: the goblin is now Fey, so Hold Person must not paralyze it or roll a save.
Ambiguity 2: AC stays a fixed 15 and the Gear line adds no extra attacks.

interactions.with: Poisoned (Disadvantage on checks lowers passive by 5)
interactions.note: The engine keeps a monster's passive at the stat-block value (red).

interactions.with: Ranged attacks with an enemy within 5 ft; long range
interactions.note: Disadvantage beyond 80 ft and with an adjacent enemy. Refused beyond 320 ft.
50 XP split among 3 PCs rounds down to 16.
The Save column equals the modifier, so PB is never added.

abuse.case: Counting Advantage that Disadvantage cancelled to trigger the extra 1d4
abuse.reason: Two Advantage sources and one Disadvantage still cancel, so the roll had no Advantage and gets no d4.

abuse.case: Dropping the Advantage rider when the GM uses static damage
abuse.reason: Static damage of a hit with Advantage is 5 + 2. The engine gives 5 (red).

abuse.case: Using Nimble Escape for an action other than Disengage or Hide (Dash)
abuse.reason: The engine turns an unknown option into Hide instead of refusing it (red).

abuse.case: Taking two Bonus Actions in one turn
abuse.reason: Only one Bonus Action per turn.
The engine refuses it but cites no page (red).
An Incapacitated creature can't take Bonus Actions.

abuse.case: Taking a Bonus Action Disengage with no feature that grants it
abuse.reason: The disengage command lets a wolf disengage as a Bonus Action (red).

abuse.case: Taking a Bonus Action Disengage with no feature that grants it (direct call)
abuse.reason: The engine refuses it but cites no page (red).

abuse.case: Giving a monster an attack its stat block lacks (a Goblin's Dagger)
abuse.reason: The engine refuses it but cites no page (red).
After 30 ft no movement is left.

abuse.case: Hiding in plain view of an enemy
abuse.reason: Hide needs the goblin out of any enemy's line of sight.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: MONSTER.goblins.goblin-warrior: 'if the attack roll had Advantage'. Does Advantage that Disadvantage cancelled still trigger the extra 1d4?
rulings_proposed.ruling: Reading A. The extra 1d4 applies only when the attack roll is resolved with Advantage (two d20s, take the higher). If Advantage and Disadvantage cancel, however many sources each side has, there is no bonus die.

rulings_proposed.ambiguity: MONSTER.goblins.goblin-warrior: 'Gear Leather Armor, Scimitar, Shield, Shortbow'. Does the Gear line track hand use (stowing the Shield to fire the two-handed Shortbow) or recalculate AC?
rulings_proposed.ruling: Reading A. The stat block's actions are used as written. AC stays at the listed 15 whatever the goblin attacks with, and Gear grants no attacks beyond those in the Actions section.

output.summary:
I wrote 97 tests for the Goblin Warrior: 95 in `tests/srd/test_monsters.py` and 2 in the journey `tests/srd/journeys/test_goblin_warrior_journey.py`. All pass: 90 are green and the 7 marked as known engine bugs (`xfail(strict)`) fail as expected.

**Fixes from the last attempt's failed checks:**
- **Ability-score tests:** the parametrized #6–#11 tests are now 18 separate functions, each with its own `@pytest.mark.srd` marker: score/modifier/save (positive), save one short of the DC (boundary) and no proficiency bonus (negative).
- **Missing tests added:**
  - #4 negative: healing can't raise HP above 10.
  - #5 negative: no movement left after 30 ft.
  - #13 negative: Gear has only the four listed items.
  - #17 boundary: R-02 split of 50 XP among three PCs rounds down to 16.
  - #18 negative: the Scimitar can't attack a target 30 ft away.
  - #19 and #22 boundaries: damage runs from 3 to 8.
- **Proposed rulings** now name only my own tests.

**Engine findings (7 red tests):**
- Static monster damage drops the +2 for an attack with Advantage.
- Nimble Escape turns an invalid option (Dash) into Hide instead of refusing it.
- The disengage command lets any creature disengage as a Bonus Action.
- A Poisoned goblin's Passive Perception doesn't drop by 5.
- Three refusals cite no page: an attack the stat block lacks, Nimble Escape out of turn, and Nimble Escape by a creature without the trait.

**MON-02 scenario test** (stage B said it under-asserts): `test_mon02_traits` now also checks no d4 without Advantage, no d4 when Advantage is cancelled, and the Shortbow's d4 with Advantage. The abuse catalogue gained entries for misusing Nimble Escape, the Advantage rider and the Gear line.

I proposed rulings for both stage-A ambiguities, each reading A: cancelled Advantage gives no d4, and the Gear line neither changes the fixed AC 15 nor adds attacks.
